description: This file defines the 'FrontPanelConfig' class responsible for managing front panel indicators, text displays, and colors in a device configuration context. It includes class declarations, member functions, and references to other front panel component classes.

classes.name: FrontPanelConfig
classes.description: Class for managing front panel indicators, text displays, and colors in devices.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of FrontPanelConfig.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns reference to a color object by id or name.

methods.name: getIndicator
methods.description: Returns reference to an indicator object by id or name.

methods.name: getTextDisplay
methods.description: Returns reference to a text display object by id or name.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns list of all color objects.

methods.name: getIndicators
methods.description: Returns list of all indicator objects.

methods.name: getTextDisplays
methods.description: Returns list of all text display objects.

methods.name: fPTerm
methods.description: Terminates or cleans up the front panel configuration.
